correctness_confidence.basis: All analytical formulas (Pauli layer counts, symplectic Z-twirling, Eq. 2 CNF Fourier weights, Eq. 3 norm bound, Eq. 4 Taylor bound, Eq. 5 advantage transfer) and all 16 rational certificates C01-C16 check out exactly against independent calculation.

rigor.basis: Proofs of the twirling projection, disjoint-clause Parseval identity, operator-norm Fourier tail bound, and positive Taylor denominator bound are complete, and Section 5 explicitly separates machine-checked lemmas from imported circuit-level results.

novelty.basis: The separation itself and proof architecture belong to Sun and Wang [7]; this paper contributes a constructive zero-float Lean 4.36.0 formalization and exact closed-form finite rational certificates (C01-C16) for the supporting spectral and Taylor bounds.

significance.basis: Provides exact, floating-point-free rational benchmarks and machine-checked algebraic identities backing recent BQAC0/qpoly lower bounds, 2-design ceilings, and NLTS weight bounds, though the core circuit localization theorem remains unformalized.

reproducibility.basis: All mathematical formulas, parameters (n, d, m, w, K), and rational outputs for C01-C16 are fully specified in the PDF for independent verification, though the external Lean proofs, pytest suite, and SHA-256 hashes cannot be audited in PDF-only mode.

summary: This manuscript presents PAULI-AC0-BQAC0-CERT-1.0, a constructive Lean 4.36.0 and exact-rational verification suite formalizing the supporting Pauli-spectrum, Boolean Fourier, Z-twirling, stretched-exponential, and advantage-transfer inequalities underlying Sun and Wang's recent proof that AC0 is not contained in BQAC0/qpoly. Independent checking confirms that every formula and numerical bound in the paper is mathematically exact: the sublinear Pauli subspace counts (C01-C03), symplectic Z-twirling projection and Frobenius contraction (Theorem 2.1, C04-C05), exact generating-function Fourier weights for disjoint monotone depth-2 CNFs and squared operator-norm lower bounds (Eq. 2, Theorem 3.1, C06-C10), zero-float Taylor upper bounds for stretched exponentials (Theorem 4.1, C11-C14), and Holder/triangle advantage transfer (Proposition 4.2, C15-C16). Crucially, Section 5 transparently delineates the verification boundary, acknowledging that Sun and Wang's circuit-level product-projection localization theorem, asymptotic worst-case hardness, and NLTS Hamiltonian construction are imported rather than proved in Lean. No mathematical errors or unresolved objections remain.
strengths: Every mathematical identity and numerical certificate C01-C16 is exact, including closed-form CNF Fourier weights W_k(f_{m,w}) in Eq. 2 and variance tails up to n = 44 (C06-C10).
Zero-float stretched-exponential certificates (Theorem 4.1) rigorously replace floating-point exponentials with exact positive rational Taylor bounds using factorial denominators.
Section 5 states the verification boundary honestly, clearly distinguishing the 20 machine-checked Lean theorems from the imported circuit-level localization theorem of Sun and Wang [7].
Figures 1-3 and Table 1 accurately match the exact analytical formulas across all parameter regimes, including the non-monotonic jumps in ceiling(sqrt(n)) Pauli fractions.
weaknesses: The central circuit-level product-projection localization theorem of Sun and Wang [7] and the NLTS Hamiltonian construction [2] are imported from literature and not formalized in Lean.
Exhaustive twirling certificates cover only n = 2, 3 (C04-C05) and advantage-transfer certificates C15-C16 test illustrative rational parameters rather than circuit-derived epsilon.

Minor editorial imprecisions: page 2 describes the 4^{-n} sum_{k<=ceil(sqrt(n))} C(n,k) 3^k collapse as super-exponential (true in d, exponential in n) and writes PAULI-ACO-BQACO-CERT-1.0 with letter O.
Theorem 2.1 lists the operator-norm non-expansiveness bound alongside Lean T06 without stating in-theorem that T06 only formalizes Frobenius contraction (clarified later in Section 5).
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact closed-form generating-function expression for degree-k Fourier weight W_k(f_{m,w}) of disjoint monotone depth-2 CNFs (Eq. 2) paired with exact-Q tail certificates up to n = 44.
Constructive zero-float rational Taylor certification scheme (Theorem 4.1) for stretched-exponential 2-design and NLTS spectral ceilings without Classical.choice or floating-point arithmetic.
